### The unlock, judged by CONTENT rather than by card state

⛔ 「the blocker card is closed」 is not the judge — what this card waits on is the ledger actually learning a root path. All four readings taken here:

| reading | value |
|:--|:--|
| card #19329 | `closed` / `state_reason: completed` |
| its PR #19639 on `origin/main` | `3a9b07f3b`, **single parent** |
| the capability itself | `packages/spec/src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts:139` — `const ROOT_PATH = '(root)';` |
| control, same instrument and file | `censusRefusals` / `nestedLists` ⇒ 16 hits, so the grep is reading the file |

⇒ the root coordinate exists on `main`. This card's own words — 「none can be recorded until the ledger learns a root path」 — are satisfied.

⚠️ The sibling prerequisite the split also named, the **ADR-0010 framework-field skip**, landed in the same PR and is scoped to the root coordinate only (`offerableKeysAt`: the filter is reachable only when `path === ROOT_PATH`). So the overlay is skipped at the root and nowhere else, which is the shape this split assumed.

### ⭐ The 145 in this card's title and body is WRONG — it is 142

Measured on `744a0a3f1` by the dev of #19329, with the reconciliation gate's **own helper block sliced verbatim**, a lit control (`name`, offered by 17 of 17 forms) and a dark control (fabricated key ⇒ 0):

```
top-level authorable keys not offered   274
of those, the ADR-0010 overlay          132
274 − 132                             = 142     ⛔ not 145
```

⇒ the card's `274 / 132 / 145` cannot all be readings of one population — the arithmetic does not close. Every other figure in the split reproduced. The dev reported the divergence instead of bending its measurement to the card, which is the right call, and this seat verified the reasoning rather than the count being merely asserted.

**Whoever takes this card re-derives the population on the tree of that day and uses what it prints** — ⛔ do not inherit 145, and ⛔ do not inherit 142 either: both are readings of trees that will have moved. The title still says 145 and is left alone; correcting a title is not worth a second write against a number that must be re-measured anyway.

⛔ No grading and no routing from this seat — `priority:p3` and `domain:spec` stand as triage set them.
